title: Simulacra
summary: A lightweight Python framework for synthesizing tabular patient data (e.g. DNA methylation, proteomics) and benchmarking classifiers trained on real vs. synthetic-augmented data for health and longevity research. It runs SDV's GaussianCopula, CTGAN and TVAE synthesizers to generate the augmented data and uses sdv.evaluation.single_table for quality/diagnostic reporting.
evidence: from sdv.single_table import GaussianCopulaSynthesizer; synthesizer.fit(real_data); benchmark.py uses SDV synthesizers per README
